newsitem.title: USA: Foster Wheeler sets Portugal waste/energy plant.
newsitem.headline: Foster Wheeler sets Portugal waste/energy plant.

text.p: Foster Wheeler Corp said a joint-venture team of Foster Wheeler Power Systems Inc and Paris-based Foster Wheeler Conception Etudes Entretien (FWCEE) won approval to begin building one of the largest waste-to-energy plants in the world in Portugal.

The two companies, operating as Grupo Progresso Foster Wheeler (GPFW), will build the plant in Loures, to the north of Lisbon, for Valorizacao e Tratamento de Residuos Solidos da Area Metropolitana de Lisboa (Norte) SA. (VALORSUL).

The contracted time to build the plant is 27 months and it will be capable of burning an estimated 2,000 metric tonnes of waste per day and producing the net equivalent of 43.3 megawatts of electric power, the company said.
